control_statement: Are SSO/MFA, least privilege and access review implemented?
expected_evidence: Access matrix, MFA configuration and review record

control_statement: Are vulnerability, patching, detection, response and serious-incident processes implemented?
expected_evidence: Scan, patch SLA, alerts, exercise and reporting process

control_statement: Perform automated vulnerability scanning and assessment at least weekly for ICT assets supporting critical or important functions
At least once a year, taking into account severe but plausible scenarios
